summary: Re:Zero season 3 (rows 51-66) is Arc 5 of the LIGHT NOVEL, and it maps cleanly onto MF文庫J volumes 16 -> 20 in order: 51 -> v16 (the whole volume, a 90-minute premiere), 52-54 -> v17, 55-58 -> v18, 59-62 -> v19 (complete at 62), 63-66 -> v20 (NOT complete — v20 ch 7 straddles into ep 67). All sixteen rows are ANCHORED in LN VOLUME space (end_chapter / start_chapter / volume = the volume number; chapters_adapted = the units inside it) and there are no anchor-hostile rows. All sixteen rows are CONFIRMED CANON against the light novel — the wiki mint's default is right on every one of them, and it is now typed on sources rather than defaulted: every single S3 episode title is verbatim a light-novel chapter title of volumes 16-20 (51 = v16 ch 5 劇場型悪意 … 66 = v20 ch 6 プリステラ攻防戦リザルト), read off two separately-maintained wikis' tables of contents plus the author's own web-novel index, and the licensor's sixteen per-episode synopses plus en-Wikipedia's sixteen summaries are light-novel content throughout. No row is filler and no row is mixed: the only anime-original material any source names is a set of slivers (a training montage, a Wilhelm/Reinhard flashback visual, extra lines for an Elsa phantom, two dramatisations of events the novel states off-page, and a shot of Subaru's two curses) — divergence under T28's faithfulness clause — and the only 総集編 is a rebroadcast-only split of ep 51 into 『「劇場型悪意」総集編 前編』 and 『「劇場型悪意」総集編 後編』, neither of which ever carried an episode number. Fifteen anchors are HIGH confidence; ep 54 is MEDIUM and is the one real fork: one lineage (the en wiki and its Russian translation) credits it with the opening of volume 18 chapter 1 while the Spanish wiki records no volume 18 at all and the Chinese wiki garbles it, so under R3-before-A47 the END is HELD at 17, the share is kept in chapters_adapted and a single-lineage partial records it — the reader's continue is volume 18 under either reading. Annotations: a v17-ch-4 graft on ep 51 (four wikis credit the fragment; the chapter is properly adapted by ep 53), two 'rearranged' records for the un-cross-cutting of volumes 19 and 20's simultaneous battles (ep 64 = v20 ch 4-5 then ep 65 steps back to v20 prologue/ch 1-2), a partial on ep 66 for the unfinished v20 ch 7, and divergence/abridged records for the named additions and cuts. NO repairs: all sixteen stored titles and air dates are confirmed on four sources and every date is a Wednesday. NO continue_point is delivered — the season stops mid-volume-20 and ep 67 resumes inside the same chapter (C1), so the frontier is derived from the anchors, not published as a post-series continue on a series that is still airing.

This is NOT the web novel's arc/part space (なろう 第五章1-81) and NOT any per-arc comicalization's chapter space (T24: the arc manga is a downstream licensed work, never an instrument). ARC MAP (ja-WP, the series article's 章構成): 第五章『歴史を刻む星々』（文庫第16巻 - 第20巻、アニメ第3期 第51話 - アニメ第4期 第67話）— verbatim; ja-WP's 既刊一覧 table repeats it in the 備考 column (vols 16-20 rowspan '第五章'). END 16 (A4): four independently-edited Re:Zero wikis credit the WHOLE of volume 16 to this row — en 'Volume 16 (Ch 1-Ch 5)', ru 'Том 16, главы 1-5', zh '16卷（整卷）' (= the entire volume), es 'Volumen 16'. TITLE TEST: the episode title 劇場型悪意 IS volume 16's chapter 5 title (en fandom ToC 'Chapter 5: Theatrical Malice'; zh fandom ToC '第五章：剧场型恶意'; the author's own web-novel index for 第五章　『歴史を刻む星々』 prints a section titled 『劇場型悪意』 (part 19 in the WEB-NOVEL space)). CONTENT: the licensor's 第51話 synopsis ('聖域での戦いから1年…アナスタシアの使者としてやってきたヨシュアとミミによって届けられたのは、水門都市プリステラへの招待状…プリステラへと出発したスバルたちを待っていたのは、懐かしい顔ぶれだった。') is Kadokawa's own volume-16 blurb almost sentence for sentence ('『聖域』での戦いから一年…水門都市プリステラへの招待状――…スバルたちは、水の都でアナスタシアを始めとした懐かしい顔ぶれと再会する…その裏で、蠢く悪意の胎動に気付けぬままに。'). START 16 (A10/A13): the row opens on volume 16 chapter 1 (Subaru's training, Joshua's arrival) — no leading partial of anything earlier. This row is the 90-MINUTE premiere (ja-WP: 第3期第1話は、90分拡大版として制作され、2024年8月30日より劇場にて先行上映された), which is why one row carries a whole volume. The v17 ch 4 fragment does NOT move the END (the beelzebub 46/47 lesson: a graft is not a frontier) — v17 ch 4 'ゴージャス・タイガー' is properly adapted by ep 53, which carries the same chapter in its own range.

The unproven-tail convention (advance on unknown SIZE) presumes the tail exists on two INDEPENDENT sources; it does not here, so the END stays at the furthest agreed volume and the share stays in chapters_adapted with a single-lineage partial. NOTE this costs the reader nothing: ep 54 does not finish volume 17 either (v17 ch 5's Emilia/Regulus thread continues into ep 55 — the licensor's 第55話 synopsis opens on exactly the scene 第54話 ends on: 'レグルス…困惑するエミリアは着替えを持ってきた百八十四番と呼ばれる女性にレグルスのことを聞く'), so the C1 continue lands INSIDE volume 17 either way and the next volume to open is 18 under both readings. Confidence MEDIUM because the volume seam inside this row is not page-verified. Flagged for Sean.

structure.notes:
THE INSTRUMENT AND ITS SPACE (T24, first anchors ever on this series — 0 stored anchors on all 79 rows). The source is the light novel 長月達平『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活』 (KADOKAWA / MF文庫J), so end_chapter / start_chapter / volume all carry the LN VOLUME number and chapters_adapted names the units INSIDE that volume exactly as the printed table of contents numbers them (序章 = prologue, 第N章 = chapter N). Three other spaces exist for this work and NONE of them is used here: (a) the WEB NOVEL on 小説家になろう numbers Arc 5 as 第五章　『歴史を刻む星々』 parts 1-81 plus a 幕間 — cited in this verdict only for the author's own title STRINGS, never for a position; (b) the per-arc comicalizations (『第五章 水の都と英雄の詩』, アライブ+, 高瀬若弥, serialised from 2024-02-19, 3 volumes so far) are DOWNSTREAM licensed works — never an instrument, never a position (T24: no fake manga position); (c) the anime's own numbering. 

THE BLOCK'S ARC MAP. ja-Wikipedia's 章構成 section states it verbatim: 第五章『歴史を刻む星々』（文庫第16巻 - 第20巻、アニメ第3期 第51話 - アニメ第4期 第67話） and 第六章『記憶の回廊』（文庫第21巻 - 第25巻、アニメ第4期 第68話 - ）; its 既刊一覧 table says the same in the 備考 column (vols 16-20 carry a rowspan '第五章', vols 21-25 '第六章'). So the S3 block (51-66) is Arc 5 minus its tail: rows 51-66 map onto LIGHT-NOVEL VOLUMES 16 -> 20, in order, with no skipped volume, and volume 20 is NOT finished at the finale (v20 ch 7 straddles into ep 67, which is the w1b agent's first row). The en Re:Zero Wiki's Season 3 page says the same in prose — the season adapts 'a majority of' Arc 5. 

THE VOLUME MAP, ROW BY ROW (END [START] {chapters}): 51 -> 16 [16] {v16 ch 1-5, the complete volume; + a v17 ch 4 graft}; 52 -> 17 [17] {v17 ch 1-2}; 53 -> 17 [17] {v17 ch 2-4}; 54 -> 17 [17] {v17 ch 3-5, ch 5 unfinished; + a single-lineage v18 ch 1 opening share}; 55 -> 18 [17] {v17 ch 5, v18 prologue-ch 2}; 56 -> 18 [18] {v18 ch 1-3}; 57 -> 18 [18] {v18 ch 2-3}; 58 -> 18 [18] {v18 ch 4-5}; 59 -> 19 [18] {v18 ch 5, v19 prologue-ch 2, + a v19 ch 6 fragment}; 60 -> 19 [19] {v19 ch 1-3, + a v19 ch 6 fragment}; 61 -> 19 [19] {v19 ch 3-4}; 62 -> 19 [19] {v19 ch 3, ch 5-6 — volume 19 COMPLETE}; 63 -> 20 [20] {v20 prologue-ch 3}; 64 -> 20 [20] {v20 ch 4-5}; 65 -> 20 [20] {v20 prologue, ch 1-2}; 66 -> 20 [20] {v20 ch 1, ch 6-7 — ch 7 unfinished}. The END sequence is monotone: 16,17,17,17,18,18,18,18,19,19,19,19,20,20,20,20. 

THE FOUR LINEAGES BEHIND THAT MAP. (1) FOUR separately-edited Re:Zero wikis carry a per-episode volume+chapter field — rezero.fandom.com (en), /es, /ru and /zh (checked by siteinfo: four different sitenames and bases, not aliases of one another). They agree on fourteen of the sixteen rows outright; the disagreements are informative and are reported where they matter (see ep 54, and the zh wiki's volume-number typos on eps 64-66 where it writes 19卷 for volume 20's own chapters, plus a stray '18卷（第四章）' it repeats on eps 53 and 54). (2) THE TITLE TEST: every S3 episode title is verbatim a light-novel chapter title, and the chapter lists come from two different wikis in two different languages (the en wiki's per-volume ToC in Yen Press's renderings, the zh wiki's 章节 lists) with the author's own 第五章　『歴史を刻む星々』 web-novel index as a Japanese witness for fourteen of the strings. (3) THE LICENSOR: re-zero-anime.jp/tv/story/tv3.html carries a full synopsis for each of the sixteen rows, and they line up with Kadokawa's own per-volume あらすじ for volumes 16-20 (e.g. v18: '都市庁舎奪還作戦が失敗に終わり、一時は濁流に呑まれる水門都市プリステラ' -> eps 54-56; v19: '大罪司教に占拠された都市を解放するべく、王選候補者と騎士たちがついに大罪司教と激突する！' -> eps 59-62; v20: '『強欲』と『憤怒』の大罪司教が陥落し、なおも戦いの続く水門都市' -> eps 63-66). (4) en-Wikipedia's 'Re:Zero season 3' page carries long per-episode summaries that match all of the above and is also the G59 mint source for our stored titles and dates. 

STANDING, ROW BY ROW — every row CONFIRMED CANON (a confirmed default is a result): 51 canon (all of v16; the 90-minute premiere); 52 canon (v17 ch 1-2); 53 canon (v17 ch 2-4); 54 canon (v17 ch 3-5); 55 canon (v17 ch 5 + v18 prologue-ch 2); 56 canon (v18 ch 1-3); 57 canon (v18 ch 2-3); 58 canon (v18 ch 4-5); 59 canon (v18 ch 5 + v19 prologue-ch 2); 60 canon (v19 ch 1-3); 61 canon (v19 ch 3-4); 62 canon (v19 ch 3, 5-6); 63 canon (v20 prologue-ch 3); 64 canon (v20 ch 4-5); 65 canon (v20 prologue, ch 1-2); 66 canon (v20 ch 1, 6-7). No row is filler and no row is mixed: the only anime-original material any source names is a handful of slivers (annotated as divergence), and there is no recap row in the numbered run. 

TITLES AND DATES — NO REPAIRS. All sixteen stored English titles and all sixteen stored air dates are confirmed against en-Wikipedia's 'Re:Zero season 3' table (the G59 mint source), ja-Wikipedia's 第3期 各話リスト, the licensor's STORY page and the en Re:Zero Wiki's Season 3 table. Day-of-week sweep: all sixteen dates are WEDNESDAYS (TOKYO MX's slot), with the expected two-cour gap between 襲撃編 (2024-10-02 -> 11-20, 8 rows) and 反撃編 (2025-02-05 -> 03-26, 8 rows), which ja-WP states outright. 

WHAT THE CONTEXT GOT WRONG, AND ONE LIVE HAZARD. (a) THE ASK'S PREMISE FAILED: the context says 'ja.wikipedia's episode list … the 3rd season table's 原作 column names volumes per episode'. It does not — ja-WP's 第3期 table has eight columns and NO 原作 column among them — its エピソードリスト/base/header declares Number = 話数, Title = サブタイトル, Aux0 = 脚本, Aux1 = 絵コンテ, Aux2 = 演出, Aux3 = 作画監督, Aux4 = 総作画監督, Aux5 = 初放送日 for any season. The volume map had to be built from the four wikis, the title test and the licensor/publisher content match instead; ja-WP contributes the ARC-level line, which is decisive but block-level. (b) A GOLDEN-KAMUY-CLASS CONTAMINATION HAZARD sits on en-Wikipedia's 'List of Re:Zero episodes': that page carries a SECOND '=== Season 3 (2024-2025) ===' heading under '== Break Time ==' holding the sixteen Re:ゼロから始める休憩時間 mini-anime shorts, numbered 37-52, with THE SAME SIXTEEN AIR DATES as our rows 51-66 and titles like 眠れる鬼の夜話 / エミリア陣営奮闘記 / 大瀑布フォロワーズ. Our rows are clean (they carry the TV titles), but any future scrape of that page must be scoped to the '== Episodes ==' section or it will import the shorts' titles onto the TV rows. (c) animefillerlist's Re:Zero page is at the slug /shows/re-zero-starting-life-another-world (not the id-shaped slug in the context) and holds exactly 50 data rows ending at ep 50 — confirmed, no claim on this block. animefillerguide has no page for this series at /anime/re-zero-starting-life-in-another-world/ (404). (d) The en Re:Zero Wiki's Season 3 table misprints ep 66's Japanese title as プリステラ攻略戦リザルト; ja-WP, en-WP, the licensor's STORY page, the zh wiki's ToC and the author's web novel all read 攻防戦. That is the wiki's error, not ours — our stored English title is unaffected.

HOW WIKI FIELDS ARE QUOTED HERE: the four Re:Zero wikis' per-episode volume fields are quoted as they RENDER (en 'Volume 17 (Ch 3-Ch 5)', es 'Volumen 17 (capítulo 3-5)', ru 'Том 17, главы 3-5', zh '17卷（第三章～第五章）'); the underlying wikitext wraps the volume label in [[…|…]] link markup and the es wiki adds <small>…</small>, so a byte-for-byte grep of a rendered field against the parse API's wikitext will not match — the label and the parenthetical each do. Every Japanese and English sentence quoted in single quotes in this verdict WAS grepped against the fetched bytes of the URL cited beside it.
